name: InspectionTestPlanManager
tagline: Construction ITPs in one Power Apps component – hold and witness points, inspection requests, sign-offs and NCRs.
description: A complete inspection and test plan manager for construction QA: hold, witness, review and surveillance points per lot, notice periods with short-notice agreement, inspection requests with request text, pass / fail results, contractor and client sign-offs with independence, the hold-point rule that stops work beyond an unreleased hold point, NCRs with close-out and re-inspection, an ITP matrix per lot and first-time-pass KPIs. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Hold-point rule – no work beyond an unreleased hold point
Hold / witness notice periods with short-notice agreement
Pass / fail with NCR number and close-out date
Contractor and client sign-off with independence check
NCR log with corrective action, re-inspection and subcontractor analysis
Bulk requests, passes and sign-offs with undo
